methodology: HTF Supply & Demand zone trading only. OTE/Killshot is now traded manually, outside this system. Scan Weekly and Daily zones from the Supply & Demand Pro indicator. A Daily zone sitting inside a Weekly zone is confluence (HTF Coverage), not a requirement. Trend Direction Pro bias is a confluence tag, never a hard filter.

timeframe_hierarchy.Weekly: Highest-timeframe zone context. A Weekly zone containing a Daily zone = HTF Coverage confluence. Never entered directly — it's an odds-enhancer only, confirmed by the user 2026-08-12. No Entry/SL/TP or risk tier is computed for Weekly zones.
timeframe_hierarchy.Daily: Primary zone timeframe scanned. Entry planning happens here — this is the only timeframe actually traded.

indecisive.body_percent: 49% or less of total candle range (high to low)
indecisive.implication: Balance between supply and demand — orders being accumulated. This is what forms a base.

decisive.implication: Institutional activity — one side consuming orders. Can end a base (leg-out).

explosive.body_percent: More than 75% of total candle range AND abnormally bigger than surrounding candles
explosive.implication: Clear institutional activity — strong imbalance. Highest-quality leg-out.

candle_classification.source: Compute directly from data_get_ohlcv — not indicator-dependent.

zone_detection.source: Supply & Demand Pro indicator. Two complementary reads: (1) data_get_study_values() returns the indicator's own authoritative list of CURRENTLY ACTIVE zones as 'Supply N Proximal/Distal' and 'Demand N Proximal/Distal' pairs, ORDERED NEAREST-TO-FARTHEST from current price (Supply 1 / Demand 1 = closest) — verified 2026-08-12 on OANDA:CADCHF by cross-matching its price levels almost exactly against the pine_boxes color read below. (2) data_get_pine_boxes(study_filter='Supply & Demand Pro', verbose=true) + data_get_pine_labels(study_filter='Supply & Demand Pro') give the formation/F/O/LoL tags and freshness state for those same zones by matching price ranges. Use study_values first to know WHICH zones are live and their order, then match boxes/labels by price to get their tags.
zone_detection.scan_scope: Added 2026-08-12 — this scan runs about twice a week (before market open, and midweek), not continuously, so bounding scope trades a small chance of missing a farther zone for a much cleaner report and (on Daily) avoiding the leg_out_quality history-window problem below. Weekly: nearest 2 Supply + nearest 2 Demand (Supply 1-2 / Demand 1-2 from data_get_study_values), REGARDLESS of freshness — Weekly is confluence-only (see timeframe_hierarchy), so a Touched Weekly zone is just as relevant to the HTF Coverage check as a Fresh one. Daily: nearest 3 FRESH Supply + nearest 3 FRESH Demand specifically — confirmed 2026-08-12 the user only enters Fresh Daily zones, Touched ones are not a candidate. This means checking freshness across the FULL active list from data_get_study_values (which may return more than 3 per side, e.g. Supply 1-5), not just the first 3 by index — skip Touched entries and keep counting until 3 Fresh are found (or fewer, if fewer than 3 Fresh exist — don't pad, and don't fall back to Touched ones). Only pull pine_boxes/pine_labels detail (tags, colors) for the zones actually kept in scope, not the full active list.
zone_detection.base_length: The indicator itself is filtered to a 6-candle max base — any zone it draws has already passed this. Do not re-validate base length independently.
zone_detection.leg_out_quality: Not tagged by the indicator. Compute from the candle immediately breaking the base using candle_classification. Explosive = highest quality. Decisive = acceptable. If the breaking candle reads as indecisive, the zone likely wouldn't have been drawn by the indicator in the first place — flag as unusual if it ever appears. Caveat (found 2026-08-12): older zones can sit outside the OHLCV history returned by data_get_ohlcv (capped at 300-500 bars depending on symbol/resolution) — if the formation candle isn't in range, report leg-out as 'not computed — formation predates fetched history' rather than guessing. The scan_scope cap above (nearest 2-3 per side) should keep most zones within range in practice.

indicator_tags.description: S&D Pro indicator plots zones automatically. Read tags directly — do not recompute what the indicator already tells you.

tags.timeframe: Timeframe of the zone — Weekly or Daily
tags.formation: Zone formation type — RBD, RBR, DBR, DBD (RBR/DBR = demand, RBD/DBD = supply)
tags.F: Flip zone — new demand in area of original supply or new supply in area of original demand. NOT freshness.
tags.O: Original zone — not caused by a reaction to another zone to its left
tags.LoL: Level on Top of Level — two zones stacked with gap smaller than either zone

freshness_detection.method: Read bgColor/borderColor from data_get_pine_boxes(study_filter='Supply & Demand Pro', verbose=true). CONFIRMED by the user directly on 2026-08-12 (previous versions of this file were wrong/stale, then an unconfirmed live inference — this is now ground truth). Color encodes FRESHNESS, not supply/demand type — a supply zone and a demand zone can each appear in either color depending on their own touch state.
freshness_detection.fresh: Hex #1c1c2e (RGB 28,28,46 — dark indigo/navy) = Fresh/untouched, for both supply and demand zones. As a raw int from data_get_pine_boxes this decodes with the color's alpha byte first: format is 0xAABBGGRR (blue/green/red order, NOT the usual ARGB) — e.g. bgColor 2351832092 = 0x8c2e1c1c = alpha 140, #1c1c2e.
freshness_detection.touched: Hex #787b86 (RGB 120,123,134 — neutral grey) = Touched (no longer fresh), for both supply and demand zones. E.g. bgColor 1283881848 = 0x4c867b78 = alpha 76, #787b86. Report as '1st Touch' per the journal's simplified freshness scale — this indicator doesn't appear to distinguish 1st touch from further touches, they all render #787b86.
freshness_detection.inactive: bgColor null = historical/inactive zone — ignore entirely.
freshness_detection.byte_order_warning: When decoding a raw bgColor/borderColor int, do NOT assume standard 0xAARRGGBB — this indicator's values are 0xAABBGGRR (R and B swapped). Extract as: A=(v>>>24)&0xff, B=(v>>>16)&0xff, G=(v>>>8)&0xff, R=v&0xff.

indicator_tags.fallback: If the indicator returns no data for a pair, flag that pair as UNREADABLE. Do not fall back to manual structural analysis for zone detection.

htf_coverage.description: Confluence check — does a Daily zone sit inside or immediately overlap a Weekly zone of the same direction?
htf_coverage.method: Compare each in-scope Daily zone's price range (nearest 3 per side, per zone_detection.scan_scope) against the in-scope Weekly zones of the same type (nearest 2 per side). Overlap or containment = HTF Coverage: Yes.
htf_coverage.rule: Not mandatory. Zones without HTF Coverage are still valid and reported — this is a confluence tier, not a filter.

trend_confluence.source: Trend Direction Pro — data_get_pine_tables(study_filter='Trend Direction Pro')
trend_confluence.reads: Daily row and Weekly row: Trend (Bullish/Bearish), Status (Confirmed/Unconfirmed), Strength (Trending/Ranging)
trend_confluence.rule: Tag only. A demand zone with a Bearish Daily trend is still reported, flagged as trend-conflicting rather than discarded.
trend_confluence.hard_rule: Never filter zones out based on trend. Trend is always reported alongside the zone, never used to exclude it.

valuation_confluence.source: Campus Valuation Tool (TradingView port, built later than the original TradeStation .ELD version) — data_get_pine_tables(study_filter='Campus Valuation Tool') or data_get_study_values if it's not a table
valuation_confluence.status: UNREADABLE as of 2026-08-12 — both data_get_pine_tables and data_get_study_values returned nothing on two live pairs (it doesn't even appear in the study_values list at all). Not yet fixed.
valuation_confluence.leading_theory: This is an oscillator-style indicator rendered in its own separate pane at the bottom of the chart (not an overlay on the price chart), and the user has to double-click it for it to actually display. Likely cause: TradingView doesn't actively render/compute the Pine graphics for a collapsed or not-yet-opened bottom pane, so the CDP-based read tools have nothing to read even though the study is technically added to the chart — consistent with the existing tool convention 'Pine indicators must be visible on chart for pine graphics tools to read their data.' NOT YET CONFIRMED — needs live testing.
valuation_confluence.next_step: Before attempting the valuation read: check whether the indicator's bottom pane is expanded. If there's a way to detect/force this via ui_click (clicking the indicator's name/legend in the bottom pane strip) or chart_get_state (listing indicator visibility state), try that first, then retry data_get_pine_tables/data_get_study_values. If ui_click can't target it, this may need a one-time manual step (leave the pane expanded before running prefilter/batch-prefilter) rather than a fully automated fix.
valuation_confluence.benchmark_varies_by_asset: The valuation comparison is NOT one fixed benchmark across all assets — e.g. currency pairs are read vs. DXY, other assets vs. interest rates. The indicator likely already selects the correct benchmark internally per asset; confirm this once it's actually readable, rather than assuming one comparison applies everywhere.
valuation_confluence.rule: Tag only, same as trend_confluence, pending confirmation. Never filter zones out based on valuation until explicitly revisited.

profit_check.description: Will an opposing zone block price before it reaches the fixed 2R target, or is the path clear? DAILY ZONES ONLY — see risk_tiers.scope_note.
profit_check.method: Compute entry/SL/TP per risk_rules (entry at proximal edge, SL = distal ± 33% buffer, TP = entry ± 2R). Check whether any opposing-type zone (Fresh or 1st Touch) sits between entry and the 2R target. This replaces an earlier 'scan for the nearest opposing zone' framing — TP here is always exactly 2R, not zone-derived, so the check should be against that fixed distance, not an arbitrary count of nearby zones.
profit_check.flag: If an opposing zone sits inside the entry-to-2R-target range, flag as Boxed in / limited profit potential — still surfaced, not excluded. If no opposing zone sits in that range, flag as Clear.

risk_tiers.description: Maps to the risk tiers already defined in the ote-journal Playbook. Used to suggest a tier per zone found, not to gate the scan.
risk_tiers.scope_note: CORRECTED 2026-08-12 — Weekly is never entered directly, it's purely an odds-enhancer for HTF Coverage on Daily zones. Entry/SL/TP and a risk tier are computed for DAILY zones only. Weekly zones still get reported in full (formation, freshness, leg-out, trend/valuation tags) since they're the source of the HTF Coverage confluence check, but no Entry/SL/TP or Suggested Risk Tier line — it's not a tradeable setup on its own.
risk_tiers.freshness_note: Also corrected 2026-08-12 — Daily entries are Fresh-only (see zone_detection.scan_scope). Touched Daily zones are excluded from the in-scope entry list entirely, so the tiers below are all implicitly 'Fresh Daily zone, plus...' — there's no separate Touched-Daily tier anymore.
risk_tiers.1.5%: Fresh Daily zone, Explosive or Decisive leg-out, HTF Coverage present
risk_tiers.1%: Fresh Daily zone, Decisive+ leg-out, no HTF Coverage
risk_tiers.0.5%: Fresh Daily zone that still clears the basic checklist but leg-out is not computed/indecisive, or trend-conflicting

checklist_reference: This rulebook mirrors the C1-C8 zone-setup checklist and risk tiers documented in the ote-journal Playbook. Keep both in sync — the journal is where trades get logged against this same checklist; this file is what finds the zones in the first place.

risk_rules.minimum_rr: Always exactly 2R — not a minimum floor, the fixed target. TP = entry ± 2R.
risk_rules.stop_loss: SL sits beyond the zone's distal edge (the boundary farthest from current price — deeper into the zone), offset by a buffer of 33% of the zone's own height (distal-to-proximal distance). Demand (long): SL = distal − 0.33 × (proximal − distal). Supply (short): SL = distal + 0.33 × (distal − proximal). R = |entry − SL|.
risk_rules.max_open_positions: No fixed limit — practical ceiling is ~4 open at once.
risk_rules.daily_stop_rule: Stop trading after 2 consecutive losing trades on the same day, OR when FTMO daily drawdown limit is reached — whichever comes first.

notes: OTE/Killshot is traded manually now, outside this system. This rulebook is HTF Supply & Demand only: scan Weekly + Daily zones, tag Trend Direction Pro as confluence (never a filter), read formation/flip/level-on-level/freshness directly from the indicator's own tags, compute leg-out quality from raw candles, and suggest a risk tier from zone quality. Base length is already filtered by the indicator (max 6 candles) — do not re-validate it.
